title: Equality of unimodular row classes is unit scaling
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, with no nontriviality assumption. Define U={(r,s)∈R² | ∃x,y∈R, xr+ys=1}. For v,w∈U, define rel(v,w) to mean that there exists u∈R× with uv₁=w₁ and uv₂=w₂. Then for every v,w∈U, their images in Quot rel are equal if and only if rel(v,w).
lean_statement: ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R], let U := {v : R × R // ∃ x y : R, x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1}; let rel : U → U → Prop := fun v w => ∃ u : Rˣ, (u : R) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : R) * v.1.2 = w.1.2; ∀ v w : U, Quot.mk rel v = Quot.mk rel w ↔ rel v w
